risk_note: RV2 money (settlement adjust candidates). D10-1258 / D10-1261 (08 BR-FUND-09 细则「正差批准的默认」⑤ as narrowed in couli #323, SPEC_REF 25a07f85): candidates of one sub-order and seq are compared on per-beneficiary differences ONLY when the order's commission_version differs from the seq's latest candidate group; same differences → nothing (pending kept, approved / rejected not regenerated, no superseding audit); different → as D10-780, the pending old-version candidates are set voided_stale_seq (superseded_by_version) with the audit in the same transaction, then new-version candidates are written (the key's version differs, so the unique constraint settle_adjustments_candidate_key is untouched — no migration, D10-1261). Same-version reruns are unchanged (skip); a beneficiary status change without a version change is handled at approval recompute (D10-770). approve.ts no longer voids a candidate because its commission_version differs from the order's; seq change → voided_stale_seq, recompute, zero difference approved without a voucher (D10-770 ①–④) unchanged. Differences: aligned by (user_id, role), the platform row counts as a party, bigint exact equality, row sets must match. Prerequisite tightening B1-18gk (#3192, merged) pinned the same-version keep and the approval beneficiary-row lock on main. Host: tsc 0, eslint 0; settlement/adjust unit 3; int settle-adjust-keep / generate / dedupe-diff / approve 24 files 92 green after the rebase; earlier also tighten 51, settle-adjusted-event + 2 notification suites 32.

reviews.note: Codex money review (effort medium) round 1 pass on the D10-1261 implementation (implementation diff unchanged by the later rebases): difference comparison, approval recompute, transaction idempotency. One S2 recorded, not blocking: with a non-advancing FixedClock two rejected groups of the same seq can share created_at, so 'latest group' may pick the older one and regenerate an already rejected group after a difference-neutral version bump; needs a deliberately frozen clock and repeated generate / reject, not confirmed reachable in normal operation.

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests (fresh independent Claude): attempt 1 rewrote four frozen settle-adjust cases in place (D10-1259, none deleted) and added settle-adjust-dedupe-diff/approve.int; container red needed red_exempt + red_exempt_outside for the unchanged '[AC-B2-09zb#8] 一单写到一半失败' block of atomic.int.test.ts (ledger patches #3185, #3187; the file's own import / constant changed). Codex spec-test r1 fail 2×S1: ① same seq + same version, difference changed — attempt 2 added same-version.int [AC-B1-18g#9]; ② approval account-row lock — out_of_scope per D10-1260 (existing behaviour, green on base). r2 pass. Then D10-1261 narrowed ⑤ (same version is not regenerated): attempt 3 rewrote #9 to the new rule, which is main's behaviour and was green on base, so D10-1262 deleted that file mechanically (not counted). Gate record (not counted) after the SPEC_REF rebase raised one S1 (no test pinned same-version keep) → D10-1263 landed tightening B1-18gk (#3192) adding [AC-B1-18gk#1] same-version keep and #2 approval lock on main; the next gate record (not counted) passed and confirmed the red_exempt test body is identical to the base. Not adopted: r1 S1 ① under D10-1261; S1 ② recorded per D10-1260 and covered by B1-18gk.
